datasets.name: dept_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT department, item_volume, volume_share_pct, reorder_rate_pct,
       avg_days_between_orders, median_days_between_orders, orders, products_sold
FROM department_kpis

datasets.name: daily_total
queryLines:
SELECT ds, SUM(items) AS items, SUM(orders) AS orders
FROM department_daily_demand
GROUP BY ds

datasets.name: peak_hours
queryLines: SELECT order_hour, total_orders, pct_of_total FROM peak_order_hours

datasets.name: dow_dept
queryLines: SELECT department, order_dow, day_name, items FROM department_demand_by_dow

datasets.name: forecast
queryLines:
SELECT ds, department, series, value
FROM forecast_eval
UNPIVOT (value FOR series IN (actual, xgboost, seasonal_naive))

datasets.name: metrics
queryLines:
SELECT department, model,
       ROUND(mae, 1) AS mae, ROUND(rmse, 1) AS rmse, ROUND(mape, 1) AS mape_pct,
       CASE WHEN is_champion THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS champion, test_start, test_end
FROM forecast_metrics

datasets.name: anomalies_latest
queryLines:
SELECT department, ds, actual, ROUND(forecast, 1) AS forecast,
       ROUND(deviation_pct, 1) AS deviation_pct, severity, model
FROM demand_anomalies
WHERE is_latest

datasets.name: anomaly_counts
queryLines:
SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS department_days
FROM demand_anomalies
GROUP BY severity

datasets.name: dq_latest
queryLines:
SELECT stage, check_name, severity,
       CASE WHEN passed THEN 'PASS' WHEN severity = 'error' THEN 'FAIL' ELSE 'WARN' END AS status,
       observed, expected, details, checked_at
FROM dq_check_results
WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_at) FROM dq_check_results)

datasets.name: dq_counters
queryLines:
SELECT COUNT_IF(passed) AS passed_checks,
       COUNT(*) AS total_checks,
       COUNT_IF(NOT passed AND severity = 'error') AS blocking_failures,
       COUNT_IF(NOT passed AND severity = 'warn') AS warnings,
       MAX(checked_at) AS last_checked
FROM dq_check_results
WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_at) FROM dq_check_results)

datasets.name: dq_history
queryLines:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, MIN(checked_at) AS run_time FROM dq_check_results GROUP BY run_id
)
SELECT r.run_time,
       CASE WHEN c.passed THEN 'passed' WHEN c.severity = 'error' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'warning' END AS status,
       COUNT(*) AS checks
FROM dq_check_results c JOIN runs r USING (run_id)
GROUP BY r.run_time, status

lines: 3.4M Instacart orders through bronze, silver and gold Delta tables. Dates on the time axis are *estimated* from each customer's real gaps between orders (the public data has no calendar dates); weekdays and gaps are measured.
